body:
Thank you for your contribution to Django! This pull request has one or more items that need attention before it can be accepted for review.
🛑 Error: Missing Trac Ticket This PR does not include a valid Trac ticket reference. **What to do:** 1. Visit https://code.djangoproject.com and find or file the appropriate ticket for your change. 2. Wait for the ticket to be triaged and accepted before submitting a PR. Patches submitted against unreviewed tickets are unlikely to be merged. 3. Edit the **Trac ticket number** section of your PR description to include the ticket in the format `ticket-NNNNN` (e.g. `ticket-36991`). For PRs with fewer than 80 lines changed (additions + deletions), you may write `N/A` in the ticket field instead (e.g. `N/A - typo fix`).
🛑 Error: Missing PR Description Your PR description must be substantive and meaningful. The placeholder text "*Provide a concise overview of the issue or rationale behind the proposed changes.*" is not acceptable. **What to do:** Write a description that contains at least 5 words and addresses: - What problem does this PR solve? - Why is this change necessary? - What approach did you take? A meaningful description helps reviewers understand the intent of your change quickly and increases the likelihood that your PR will be reviewed promptly.
🛑 Error: AI Tool Usage Not Disclosed You must select exactly one checkbox in the AI Assistance Disclosure section of your PR description. **What to do:** Change `[ ]` to `[x]` for either: 1. "**No AI tools were used** in preparing this PR." OR 2. "**If AI tools were used**, I have disclosed which ones, and fully reviewed and verified their output." **Key Requirements:** - Select only one option - Do not check both boxes - Do not leave both unchecked - If selecting the second option, provide details of which AI tools were used.
🛑 Error: Incomplete Checklist The items in the **Checklist** section must be all understood and checked accordingly before this PR can be accepted. These items confirm that you have read and followed the [Django contributing guidelines](https://docs.djangoproject.com/en/dev/internals/contributing/writing-code/submitting-patches/). **What to do:** - Review each item and change `[ ]` to `[x]` once you have completed it.
If you have questions about these requirements, please review the [contributing guidelines](https://docs.djangoproject.com/en/dev/internals/contributing/writing-code/submitting-patches/) or ask for help on the [Django Forum](https://forum.djangoproject.com/c/internals/mentorship/10).
